title: Keycloak
description: Sign-ins, tokens, errors, security events, HTTP and runtime health of Keycloak (auth.example.com).

panels.title: Status
panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape Keycloak's management port (keycloak:9000/metrics).

panels.title: Sign-ins
panels.description: Successful logins in the selected time range (browser, password and direct grants).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({container="keycloak"} |= "[org.keycloak.events]" | regexp `^\S+ \S+ (?P<level>\w+)` | regexp `type="(?P<type>[^"]+)"` | regexp `realmName="(?P<realm>[^"]*)"` | regexp `clientId="(?P<client>[^"]*)"` | regexp `ipAddress="(?P<ip>[^"]*)"` | realm=~"$realm" | client=~"$client" | type="LOGIN" [$__range]))

panels.title: Failed sign-ins
panels.description: Failed logins: wrong credentials, unknown users, access denied by the admin-only flow, lockouts.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({container="keycloak"} |= "[org.keycloak.events]" | regexp `^\S+ \S+ (?P<level>\w+)` | regexp `type="(?P<type>[^"]+)"` | regexp `realmName="(?P<realm>[^"]*)"` | regexp `clientId="(?P<client>[^"]*)"` | regexp `ipAddress="(?P<ip>[^"]*)"` | realm=~"$realm" | client=~"$client" | type="LOGIN_ERROR" [$__range]))

sum(count_over_time({container="keycloak"} |= "[org.keycloak.events]" | regexp `^\S+ \S+ (?P<level>\w+)` | regexp `type="(?P<type>[^"]+)"` | regexp `realmName="(?P<realm>[^"]*)"` | regexp `clientId="(?P<client>[^"]*)"` | regexp `ipAddress="(?P<ip>[^"]*)"` | realm=~"$realm" | client=~"$client" | type="LOGIN" [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({container="keycloak"} |= "[org.keycloak.events]" | regexp `^\S+ \S+ (?P<level>\w+)` | regexp `type="(?P<type>[^"]+)"` | regexp `realmName="(?P<realm>[^"]*)"` | regexp `clientId="(?P<client>[^"]*)"` | regexp `ipAddress="(?P<ip>[^"]*)"` | realm=~"$realm" | client=~"$client" | type=~"LOGIN|LOGIN_ERROR" [$__range]))

panels.title: Tokens issued
panels.description: Authorization-code exchanges, refreshes, client-credentials and token exchanges.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({container="keycloak"} |= "[org.keycloak.events]" | regexp `^\S+ \S+ (?P<level>\w+)` | regexp `type="(?P<type>[^"]+)"` | regexp `realmName="(?P<realm>[^"]*)"` | regexp `clientId="(?P<client>[^"]*)"` | regexp `ipAddress="(?P<ip>[^"]*)"` | realm=~"$realm" | client=~"$client" | type=~"CODE_TO_TOKEN|REFRESH_TOKEN|CLIENT_LOGIN|TOKEN_EXCHANGE" [$__range]))

panels.title: Event errors
panels.description: Every event that ended in an error, of any type (logins, code exchanges, refreshes, …).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({container="keycloak"} |= "[org.keycloak.events]" | regexp `^\S+ \S+ (?P<level>\w+)` | regexp `type="(?P<type>[^"]+)"` | regexp `realmName="(?P<realm>[^"]*)"` | regexp `clientId="(?P<client>[^"]*)"` | regexp `ipAddress="(?P<ip>[^"]*)"` | realm=~"$realm" | client=~"$client" | type=~".+_ERROR" [$__range]))

panels.title: Users signed in
panels.description: Distinct usernames with at least one successful login.

targets.expr: count(sum by (username) (count_over_time({container="keycloak"} |= "[org.keycloak.events]" | regexp `^\S+ \S+ (?P<level>\w+)` | regexp `type="(?P<type>[^"]+)"` | regexp `realmName="(?P<realm>[^"]*)"` | regexp `clientId="(?P<client>[^"]*)"` | regexp `ipAddress="(?P<ip>[^"]*)"` | realm=~"$realm" | client=~"$client" | regexp `username="(?P<username>[^"]+)"` | type="LOGIN" [$__range])))

panels.title: Sign-ins and tokens per client
panels.description: Successful logins and token issues, stacked by client.

targets.expr: sum by (client) (count_over_time({container="keycloak"} |= "[org.keycloak.events]" | regexp `^\S+ \S+ (?P<level>\w+)` | regexp `type="(?P<type>[^"]+)"` | regexp `realmName="(?P<realm>[^"]*)"` | regexp `clientId="(?P<client>[^"]*)"` | regexp `ipAddress="(?P<ip>[^"]*)"` | realm=~"$realm" | client=~"$client" | type=~"LOGIN|CODE_TO_TOKEN|REFRESH_TOKEN|CLIENT_LOGIN|TOKEN_EXCHANGE" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Errors by type
panels.description: Failed events by event type and error (e.g. LOGIN_ERROR: invalid_user_credentials, CODE_TO_TOKEN_ERROR: not_allowed).

targets.expr: sum by (type, error) (count_over_time({container="keycloak"} |= "[org.keycloak.events]" | regexp `^\S+ \S+ (?P<level>\w+)` | regexp `type="(?P<type>[^"]+)"` | regexp `realmName="(?P<realm>[^"]*)"` | regexp `clientId="(?P<client>[^"]*)"` | regexp `ipAddress="(?P<ip>[^"]*)"` | realm=~"$realm" | client=~"$client" | regexp `error="(?P<error>[^"]+)"` | type=~".+_ERROR" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Events per client (time range)
panels.description: Successful events in the selected range by client and event type.

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (client, type) (count_over_time({container="keycloak"} |= "[org.keycloak.events]" | regexp `^\S+ \S+ (?P<level>\w+)` | regexp `type="(?P<type>[^"]+)"` | regexp `realmName="(?P<realm>[^"]*)"` | regexp `clientId="(?P<client>[^"]*)"` | regexp `ipAddress="(?P<ip>[^"]*)"` | realm=~"$realm" | client=~"$client" | type=~"LOGIN|CODE_TO_TOKEN|REFRESH_TOKEN|CLIENT_LOGIN|TOKEN_EXCHANGE" [$__range])))

panels.title: Errors per client (time range)
panels.description: Failed events in the selected range by client, event type and error.

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (client, type, error) (count_over_time({container="keycloak"} |= "[org.keycloak.events]" | regexp `^\S+ \S+ (?P<level>\w+)` | regexp `type="(?P<type>[^"]+)"` | regexp `realmName="(?P<realm>[^"]*)"` | regexp `clientId="(?P<client>[^"]*)"` | regexp `ipAddress="(?P<ip>[^"]*)"` | realm=~"$realm" | client=~"$client" | regexp `error="(?P<error>[^"]+)"` | type=~".+_ERROR" [$__range])))

panels.title: Password checks
panels.description: Password hash validations (trend): a rise in 'invalid' is someone guessing passwords.

panels.title: Sign-ins
panels.description: Successful logins from the Keycloak event log: user, client, realm and source IP.

targets.expr: {container="keycloak"} |= "[org.keycloak.events]" | regexp `^\S+ \S+ (?P<level>\w+)` | regexp `type="(?P<type>[^"]+)"` | regexp `realmName="(?P<realm>[^"]*)"` | regexp `clientId="(?P<client>[^"]*)"` | regexp `ipAddress="(?P<ip>[^"]*)"` | realm=~"$realm" | client=~"$client" | regexp `username="(?P<username>[^"]+)"` | type="LOGIN" | line_format "{{.username}} → {{.client}} ({{.realm}}) from {{.ip}}"

panels.title: Failed sign-ins and denied requests
panels.description: Every error event (login, code exchange, refresh, …) with its error and reason.

targets.expr: {container="keycloak"} |= "[org.keycloak.events]" | regexp `^\S+ \S+ (?P<level>\w+)` | regexp `type="(?P<type>[^"]+)"` | regexp `realmName="(?P<realm>[^"]*)"` | regexp `clientId="(?P<client>[^"]*)"` | regexp `ipAddress="(?P<ip>[^"]*)"` | realm=~"$realm" | client=~"$client" | regexp `username="(?P<username>[^"]+)"` | regexp `error="(?P<error>[^"]+)"` | type=~".+_ERROR" | regexp `reason="(?P<reason>[^"]*)"` | line_format "{{.type}} {{.error}} · user={{.username}} client={{.client}} ({{.realm}}) ip={{.ip}} {{.reason}}"

topk(10, sum by (username) (count_over_time({container="keycloak"} |= "[org.keycloak.events]" | regexp `^\S+ \S+ (?P<level>\w+)` | regexp `type="(?P<type>[^"]+)"` | regexp `realmName="(?P<realm>[^"]*)"` | regexp `clientId="(?P<client>[^"]*)"` | regexp `ipAddress="(?P<ip>[^"]*)"` | realm=~"$realm" | client=~"$client" | regexp `username="(?P<username>[^"]+)"` | type="LOGIN_ERROR" [$__range])))

topk(10, sum by (ip) (count_over_time({container="keycloak"} |= "[org.keycloak.events]" | regexp `^\S+ \S+ (?P<level>\w+)` | regexp `type="(?P<type>[^"]+)"` | regexp `realmName="(?P<realm>[^"]*)"` | regexp `clientId="(?P<client>[^"]*)"` | regexp `ipAddress="(?P<ip>[^"]*)"` | realm=~"$realm" | client=~"$client" | type="LOGIN_ERROR" [$__range])))

topk(10, sum by (username) (count_over_time({container="keycloak"} |= "[org.keycloak.events]" | regexp `^\S+ \S+ (?P<level>\w+)` | regexp `type="(?P<type>[^"]+)"` | regexp `realmName="(?P<realm>[^"]*)"` | regexp `clientId="(?P<client>[^"]*)"` | regexp `ipAddress="(?P<ip>[^"]*)"` | realm=~"$realm" | client=~"$client" | regexp `username="(?P<username>[^"]+)"` | type="LOGIN" [$__range])))

panels.title: Lockouts
panels.description: Logins refused because brute-force protection has temporarily disabled the user.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({container="keycloak"} |= "[org.keycloak.events]" | regexp `^\S+ \S+ (?P<level>\w+)` | regexp `type="(?P<type>[^"]+)"` | regexp `realmName="(?P<realm>[^"]*)"` | regexp `clientId="(?P<client>[^"]*)"` | regexp `ipAddress="(?P<ip>[^"]*)"` | realm=~"$realm" | client=~"$client" | regexp `error="(?P<error>[^"]+)"` | error="user_temporarily_disabled" [$__range]))

panels.title: Rejected client requests
panels.description: Misconfigured or hostile client requests: unknown redirect URIs, scopes the client may not request, bad client secrets, offline tokens not allowed.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({container="keycloak"} |= "[org.keycloak.events]" | regexp `^\S+ \S+ (?P<level>\w+)` | regexp `type="(?P<type>[^"]+)"` | regexp `realmName="(?P<realm>[^"]*)"` | regexp `clientId="(?P<client>[^"]*)"` | regexp `ipAddress="(?P<ip>[^"]*)"` | realm=~"$realm" | client=~"$client" | regexp `error="(?P<error>[^"]+)"` | error=~"invalid_redirect_uri|invalid_request|invalid_scope|invalid_client|invalid_client_credentials|not_allowed" [$__range]))

panels.title: Latency
panels.description: Request duration percentiles over all Keycloak endpoints.

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job="keycloak"}[$__range]))))

panels.title: Garbage collection
panels.description: Seconds of GC pause per second (as a share) by cause, and the share of CPU time spent in GC.

panels.title: Database connection pool
panels.description: A non-zero 'waiting' line means requests queue for a Postgres connection.

panels.title: Container memory
panels.description: Working-set memory of the Keycloak and Keycloak DB containers (cadvisor).

panels.title: Keycloak events
panels.description: Every Keycloak event, newest first. Expand a line for all its fields.

targets.expr: {container="keycloak"} |= "[org.keycloak.events]" | regexp `^\S+ \S+ (?P<level>\w+)` | regexp `type="(?P<type>[^"]+)"` | regexp `realmName="(?P<realm>[^"]*)"` | regexp `clientId="(?P<client>[^"]*)"` | regexp `ipAddress="(?P<ip>[^"]*)"` | realm=~"$realm" | client=~"$client" | regexp `username="(?P<username>[^"]+)"` | line_format "{{.level}} {{.type}} · user={{.username}} client={{.client}} ({{.realm}}) ip={{.ip}}"
